notes.title: Summer's End
notes.content:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280850/Swing_Striker/"][/dynamiclink]

[h2]You know it belongs on your Steam wishlist! ☝️☝️☝️☝️[/h2]

Hey there, Strikers!

Summer's almost gone 🚪, but it was full of events and kept us occupied for sure. We traveled a lot and took the Swing Striker with us! One such travel led us to Dallas for DreamHack back in May!

Various folks visited, including esports stars both established and emerging. Their appreciation was humbling! We also got some vital feedback that will help us improve the game further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/c22bf1c11ad303a14120e558042555884b100685.png[/img]

[h2]So what's been going on in the project?[/h2]

We're still deep in development — sanding off the rough edges, testing new mechanics 🛠️, and occasionally asking ourselves “What if the ball had feelings?” 🤔 We don’t know where that thread leads, but we’re not ruling anything out.

Right now, we're exploring ways to complete the project and secure funding (translation: we’re juggling design docs and pitch decks like hot potatoes). But rest assured, the world will get Swing Striker. It’s just too ridiculous not to exist.

Our dedication to present the world with the answer to the “What if soccer... but unhinged?” question remains unwavering. We hope that soon enough you will also be able to grab a controller, test your reflexes, and scream like a champion when you accidentally score 🥳.

Stay flexible!
Giant Fox Studios 🦊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/72d53f25be24cf843d5a92844d52d4b99d208b9e.gif[/img]

Stay tuned and remember to

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/75121d19ec7c120f69a378e71b859b6e29b3352a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280850/Swing_Striker/

Did you remember to add it to your Steam wishlist?

Long time no see, Strikers! 🤸⚽️🦈🫡

You might have been wondering where did we go since the last announcement! The truth is, we did not go anywhere, we were just busy like bees, working on Swing Striker and our other projects.

Right now we are on GDC working towards opportunities that will allow us to take the game to the next level... as well as presenting Swing Striker to new fans. They seem to like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/66c56aafa771b24c61fdfb1bfadb04684d12d70c.png[/img]

Seriously though, what has been in the making? Lots and lots, after all we worked on things like:

🎨 Perfecting the singleplayer levels
🛠️ Polishing networking for online matchmaking and PvP games
💯 Designing rewards system
👹 Working on existing characters and brewing new ones
🖱️ Improving UI and controls
🪚 Numerous bug fixes and optimizations
😵‍💫 And more, more, more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/4cd6e8c41c68ec63b8bd36e75f9956d5f5812ca5.gif[/img]

Obviously with so much in store it will still take a while before we will be ready to share Swing Striker with the whole wide world. However, we want to tell you that from now on we are very committed to giving you regular updates.

We hope this time will fly by with the speed of a ball kicked skillfully into the goal and soon you will be hanging out with Basic B, Nautical Sam, Squid Kicks, Penny Webb, Tea Leaf and other kids!

Happy swingin'!
Giant Fox Studios 🦊

notes.title: Intro to Evercoral
notes.content:
How long does it take to create the awesome visuals you see in video games? Quite a bit longer than you might think! Our dedicated art team goes through a multistep process to create many of our designs, even the deceptively simple-seeming ones. That process includes: Concepting, prototyping, then finalizing and integration - all while reporting back to the rest of the team for feedback throughout the process. 

Check out some of the stuff we've been working on for Squid Kicks! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/a9f91d59e1e9578eff4e500873f24cd25913f793.png[/img]

Squid Kicks hails from Evercoral, a mostly ocean world that is home to a population of tough competitors and their favorite brutal sport, Battle Coral! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/faf3e9190e563f8c957c3ef6ed00e8165f3d1591.png[/img]

Here we have an overhead view of some of the many coral clusters dotting the surface of the planet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/d6bcddc12e2b7feead14fcd3ce87b64824c30571.png[/img]

You'll be able to see this art and more in the new animated intro for Squid Kicks' story mode!

notes.title: Giant Fox Studios and Swing Striker: An Introspective Look
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/093f264b095a427b0bf4ff4995e53a3d92b1a430.png[/img]

Hello to everyone from the team at Giant Fox Studios! ([i]Big Wavey Wave[/i])

If you have been following our posts over the past few months you can see that our upcoming game, Swing Striker, has received a ton of updates. Swing Striker has been in development for a little while now but GIant Fox Studios is still crafting new quality content for it everyday! We are very proud of how far we have come. This game started as a simple flash game on [b]Bored.com[/b] and was streamed by PewDiePie…

[previewyoutube=HTfdvoIaBhI;full][/previewyoutube]
…and has risen to become a fully fleshed-out modern game with advanced physics and compelling graphics! 

Swing Striker is being developed to include game modes for every type of player. The Giant Fox Studios team has been working on crafting a single-player campaign that will provide many hours of universe spanning puzzles, monster bashing, and mystery solving entertainment. You will get a chance to play with your favorite Swing Striker, learn their story, and master their special abilities. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/rUv9inIhK5hg5QZanm/giphy.gif[/img]

Swing Striker has a robust multiplayer experience. Dozens of unique stadiums with their own challenges await you and your friends. Prove your superiority with precision and timing in our Swing Striker mode while showing your ferocity in our Deathmatch stadiums. Don’t have friends? Don’t worry! We will have matchmaking available!   

Giant Fox Studios has made many quality games and Swing Striker may be our most ambitious project yet. Because of this we are spending the time to make sure that when we bring this game to you it will be polished, tested, and at its fullest potential. 

Thank you for supporting us and wishlisting this game. All of us at Giant Fox Studios really appreciate you, our fans, for keeping an eye on our posts and looking forward to our future releases. We would be nothing without you! Come hang out with us on Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/TMuEhveS3f]Giant Fox Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: Giant Fox Studios Gives a Sneak Peek At Our Most Powerful Playable Character Yet
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/dec115fd4c75d91978abfbb2c53006aaa6c953cb.png[/img]

The universe is a big place full of scary and dangerous people. Those dangerous people all fear Slick, the universe's top assassin. Slick is quick and nimble with plenty of tricks up his sleeve. Slick is a big part of why Swing Striker is the universe-wide phenomenon that it is now, even if he didn’t intend it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/e179bdf60af1a6dd8f79dfdbf5695eda0f855077.png[/img]

Slick is done with that life, however, and now practices his “fine art” on his Swing Striker opponents. Since joining the Swing Striker league he has made a different type of name for himself by proving to be the strongest challenger in the game. A big reason for his success seems to be that, despite it being against Swing Striker regulations, he carries his rocket launcher into the stadium, blasting his fellow Strikers to bits whenever the urge hits him.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qFxo3wHx8wX8Ku9qe4/giphy.gif[/img]

The team over at Giant Fox Studios always gets a bit nervous when someone chooses Slick as their Striker. Time and time again his rocket ability keeps everyone playing against him in check. We have spent quite a bit of time tweaking and balancing his special ability but one thing has remained true, it’s an explosion of fun!  

While you are waiting to try out Slick’s awesome rocket for yourself, why don’t you spend the time playing one of our other titles? Did you know we don’t only make PC games? In fact, most of our team has worked on some of your favorite mobile games! One of our most successful is Toadled, a game we are still getting rave reviews about to this day. Check out Toadled here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/521630/Toadled/]Toadled on Steam[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/0c41f48debc39a658d225fb4543698c19dff17a1.png[/img]

notes.title: The Swing Striker Team Plays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/6ac04955eaa23180283290b7776f8fc187659574.png[/img]

With so much QA and bug fixing, who has time to play games?? Well, we do! Every week, the Giant Fox team hops online to play our game together. This is an important thing for us! We work remotely nowadays and it's nice to be able to spend some time as a team with something fun. And, with that in mind, what could be more fun than playing Swing Striker??  

During our playtest sessions silly things happen all the time and bugs show themselves. This was certainly a big one:

[previewyoutube=_jJ3jMSuWMo;full][/previewyoutube]

Whelp, looks like our development team has some more work to do! Of course, this is all part of the process of building and creating games. The development team spends a lot of time making sure the playing process is smooth and bug free. They do that while keeping up with requests for new mechanics and abilities from the design team. 

Now, just because we are playing games this week doesn’t mean that we aren’t still working hard to make Swing Striker great! This week, we have put the finishing touches on some of our newest levels. There are many steps to getting a level from concept to in-game. Check out this early concept sketch for a sneak peak into the future of Swing Striker! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/346e786d1408b1f06527463294fe713ce310dd84.png[/img]

Until next time!

notes.title: New Levels, Power-Ups and Character Abilities Offer Endless Possibilities!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/13c1706188b7cbf877b28ffa1c3e9581849bf528.png[/img]

The unbelievably talented, compellingly unique and incredibly handsome Giant Fox team is working hard to bring Swing Striker’s new abilities and power-ups to life. We are going to be highlighting a few of these over the next few weeks so check back in for regular updates.

These new abilities we are going to highlight take time to develop in order to ensure they are the best for future players. We have grown as a team and through that have a new QA process to develop new ideas. Finding and knocking out bugs is a part of this process. Our development team has done a great job of clearing out the backlog and gearing towards the future with a new Demo version to be released soon! 

This week we want to show you “The Golden Boot!” This giant golden clodhopper plows through your opponents and kicks the ball right where you want it. We love to consider mechanics for players that are easy to pick up but hard to master, and this is certainly one of them. Make sure to grab this power-up and guarantee yourself a victory before your friends do! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/f294cb6ed4e4bf8e74d2a66fe85bc4a7246547f3.png[/img]

Our QA team has created this GIF to show you the perfect Golden Boot shot, but can you see the other abilities on display as well?

notes.title: INKredible Swing Striker: Squid Kicks
notes.content:
All of us at Giant Fox Studios are excited about the progress we’ve made on our game Swing Striker this past month! 

Our development team has made great strides in crafting the new character abilities and testing new game modes for our players.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/669828558f3c5427b7c1a3b37c12edc076fc5223.png[/img]

QA has been a focus this month and the team has been combing through our game to make sure it is polished and ready for our fans. 

You have seen many of our wacky characters, but where do they come from? Many of our Swing Strikers had to overcome great obstacles to get to where they are today. This past month we have spent a lot of time on a very INKredible Swing Striker, Squid Kicks. Her journey will lead you to places you won't expect and provide challenges you can’t resist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/d80b027091ed97ac2e2fd10160a72a6bc31c062b.png[/img]

notes.title: Swing Striker is Getting Bigger and Better!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/fb517ff4840cde8da1c3d7c53ee81e808f857fad.png[/img]

Impatient to play? We hear you! Swing Striker’s development team has expanded in order to provide quality content at an even quicker pace. With this new approach, our team has been able to implement some new features which should create hours of exciting content for you all to play! 

[u]Some of our new features[/u]:
- A longer single-player mode with awesome platforming levels and an intricate story  
- A DeathMatch Mode which is pure, glorious carnage and fun
- Unique special character abilities - For example, Squidkicks can now #ShootDaBoot!

[previewyoutube=wyMA7ranmB4;full][/previewyoutube]
   
We really appreciate the feedback we’ve received from our Beta Testers and have released a brand new demo version that addresses many of the issues you brought to our attention! We will have more updates coming soon. We hope that you continue to play and tell us what you think during this exciting time in our development!

Join our Discord for the latest info about the game and to chat with us directly about your ideas on how we can improve Swing Striker! [url=https://discord.com/invite/TMuEhveS3f]https://discord.com/invite/TMuEhveS3f[/url]

notes.title: Who's the best at Swing Striker?
notes.content:
Hey G.Rounders! How's your week been? We've been busy squashing more bugs than we can count thanks to your help, keep 'em coming!

Btw, did you see us getting owned at our own game on Bram's stream last week? 😂 It was awesome to play against pro gamers. Just because we made the game it doesn't mean we're the best at it.. 😛 Check it out here if you missed it- https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1294554559?t=00h15m00s

But who is the best? Our team has been debating which of our devs is the best at Swing Striker? Who would win- engineers that built the game QA that's done hundreds of hours of testing, the designers that thought it up, or the artists that created the characters? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/5f030ea41c4671829ca46ce776321bf2d1ebd5a7.png[/img]

See you there!

notes.title: New Costumes and Some Bug Squashing
notes.content:
WOW, what an awesome week this has been! We've been reading through every review and watching all of the videos. Thank you so much for all of the amazing feedback given.

We're already making improvements to the game based on what you've said! A new build of Swing Striker just went live a few moments ago. Here's what's new!
- Fixed most critical issues (there are still some issues if you play multiple matches in a row
- Made it easier to unlock skins/costumes and they sync online now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/e0a92cdb4cd9416dba62d21e5d00f9608211283c.png[/img]

Here's what we're working on next:
- Fixing remaining major bugs
- Adding a rematch button for private online matches
- Adding an option to play against a bot in competitive mode

If you run into any bugs while playing, please press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B to report a bug to us right in-game and put it in your review over at the website. It's a HUGE help for us!

Also, there's a Swing Striker community game night on G.Round at 10am EST today- https://www.twitch.tv/gameroundco

A few of the developers will be there, so come by, chat with us, and see if you have what it takes to beat us at our own game!

Swing Striker is a local competitive game all about intergalactic grappling-hook soccer, so who knows what kind of crazy level Sean will make this time!

notes.title: And We're Live!
notes.content:
Why hello everyone! Thank you for caring enough about our game to read this! We really appreciate it and want to do everything we can to make it as awesome for you as possible. Now without further ado, introducing, SWING STRIKER! :D

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lOahmXh39CZm9wzlDX/giphy.gif[/img]

Oh man, where do we begin? If you think Swing Striker looks familiar, it might be because you played it 8 years ago as a Flash game! Originally called Swing Soccer, the game was created while the team was working at bored.com and did extremely well after PewDiePie did a let's play review of it almost a decade ago. Here's the OG version for comparison on where we are now:

[previewyoutube=HTfdvoIaBhI;full][/previewyoutube]

Since then we've been busy with a whole bunch of other projects for clients or indie game releases and full time jobs. For the past year and a half or so though we've been working on rereleasing Swing Soccer in the full glory we always wanted it to be, giving it a full reskin, epic backstory, and gamepad controls that make the game WAY more enjoyable than the Flash version ever could have. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/MEWgNSnv4jlvxaFm0l/source.gif[/img]

We've made great progress on the game, have shown a demo at quite a few expos before quarantine hit, and now getting ready to release the game on Steam later this year! We're working on getting a free demo of Swing Striker up for the Steam Game Festival in June. Wishlist it now to make sure you get notified when it's available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37581306/f3f947bf6ef498823c2ec70ae54feab54b08853c.png[/img]

Thanks again for reading and being interested in our game! We can't wait to hear what you think of the game when you play. Remember the wishlist it now if you haven't yet! www.bit.ly/swingstriker

- The Giant Fox Studios Team
